The next back gesture reaches Issues, extending the navigation detour rather than collecting either statistic. By step 30 the trajectory returns to the repository Code page, visibly interrupting and correcting that particular navigation mechanism. Later scrolling reveals 15 contributors, but no star count is visibly identified through step 50, so the statistics predicate is only partially satisfied.

summary: The reused history amplifies an existing repository-navigation misconception by prompting another back-style action. That mechanism is later interrupted when the trajectory returns to the Code page. The contributor count becomes visible, while the star count remains unobserved in the supplied trace.
